Final head for L1 · area a4-U · 2026-11-25T04:59Z
Head-sha: `adfe34959431666411ce5a1a54535496a6274526`

- `RelatedList.tsx` keeps a `countKnown` state. It is set the first time a read settles: not loading, no load failure, and no refused filter.
  - `countPending` also requires `!countKnown`, so a refetch over a list that already answered 0 keeps drawing 0.
  - A first read in flight still draws nothing, which keeps the #36235 rule.
  - A list that answered rows behaves as before.
- Pins: a top-level `describe` for #36822 in the existing harness `RelatedList.countPending-36235.test.tsx`.
  - The 0-row refetch pin holds the refetch in flight and reads `0` on that frame. A MutationObserver records no other reading across the refetch.
  - The N-rows pin shows `2` while the refetch is held, then `0`.
  - The #36235 controls stay green.
- Ablation: reverting `!countKnown` turns the 0-row refetch pin red (1 of 5, `expected null to be '0'`). The N-rows pin and the #36235 pins stay green, because that behaviour held before the fix. Restored to blob == HEAD.
- Readings, from the dev: plugin-detail 3943 tests passed; plugin-detail type-check exit 0; 38 derived gate families all exit 0; overlap-check clean.
- Acceptance note: `countKnown` is not reset when the parent or filter changes, so a reparented list draws its last count during the new read. A list whose last answer had rows already does this.
- Check-runs at this head: 42 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing or running.
- Handed to the seat session for L1. This zone does not ready or queue the PR before an ACCEPT on this head.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `adfe34959431666411ce5a1a54535496a6274526` · 2026-11-25T05:05Z

- Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37220`, CLEAN, 13 items): open, draft, base `main`. First line is `Fixes #36822`, and no closing keyword binds any other card. Two commits, 3 files, +80/-1. One `patch` changeset covers `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. No `content/docs/releases/` path and no NUL suspects. This fits the XS budget: 12 lines of code, 59 of pin.
- Declarations: `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear in both the PR body and the changeset. Both are correct, since the change is UI-internal and touches no accept set, public surface or metadata.
- i18n is untouched. The diff has no locale file and no new `t()` key.
- Check-runs at `adfe349594`: 55 total, 42 success, 13 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (16/16 shards) and `Build & E2E UI` are all `success`. The zone note's count 2026-11-25T05:00:05Z matches.
- K = 5 (merge-base `886e97073d`). `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` is clean, and main has not touched `ui/packages/plugin-detail/` since the merge-base.
- Overlap:
  - #37212 is a card, not a PR. Its branch `claude/issue-37212-drawer-related-table-update-loop` sits at main with no commits yet, so there is nothing to diff. The new `useEffect` is idempotent (it only sets `true`), so it adds no update-loop risk for the #185 drawer case. Re-run merge-tree once that branch has commits.
  - #37215 changes `RelatedList.tsx` at the imports and near line 1577, far from line 4028. `merge-tree` is clean.
- Done-when mapping:
  - Acceptance "refetch answering 0 shows 0, no frame without it" maps to pin 1 (held in-flight frame plus MutationObserver).
  - Acceptance "a list that answers rows keeps today's behaviour" maps to pin 2 and the three #36235 pins.
  - The zone reports that ablating `!countKnown` turns pin 1 red (`expected null to be '0'`). I did not re-run it: `ui/node_modules` is absent here and the rules forbid a checkout.
- Keying: `RelatedList` has one in-tree call site (`record-related-list.tsx:702`), and it carries no `key`. So `countKnown` is never reset on a parentId or filter change. `relatedData` is not cleared on those changes either, so a reparented list already drew its previous non-zero count during the new read. Carrying that to 0 is what the card's Expected asks for ("after a delete, a filter, or a reparent … shows the last known count"). The PR's Acceptance notes disclose it. Accepted as designed.
- First read that errors: `readSettled` stays false, `countKnown` stays false, and Retry draws no count. That is correct.
- M1 (must-fix) — `countKnown` survives a failed read whose rows were cleared, so Retry draws a false 0.
  - Trace: a list answers 2 rows, so `countKnown` becomes true. A refetch then rejects, and the `find` `.catch` (around line 2380) runs `setRelatedData([])`, `setTotal(null)` and `setLoadFailure(...)`. `handleRetryRead`, or a later `objectui:related-changed` refetch, sets `loadFailure=null` and `loading=true`. At that point `countPending = … && !countKnown …` is false, so the badge draws `recordCount = relatedData.length = 0`.
  - The badge reads `0` for the whole retry, where pre-fix it was blank. That is neither the last known count (2) nor a known count, which breaks the card's Expected and the #36235 "never a false 0" rule.
  - The new comment ("A failed or refused read … never marks one known") holds, but it never un-marks one.
  - Fix: clear `countKnown` when a read fails, for example `if (loadFailure) setCountKnown(false)` in the same effect, or set `countKnown` from the read's own resolve and reject paths.
  - Pin it in the #36822 describe: answer `ROWS`, then make the refetch reject, then hold Retry's read and assert `headBadge()` is `null`, not `'0'`. Include an ablation reading.
- M2 (must-fix) — the changeset's second sentence and the 维护者速读 "出错会怎样" line are false at this head.
  - The changeset says "a later reload keeps drawing the last count until the new one lands". The 速读 says "最坏是刷新期间角标显示上一次的数字".
  - Under M1 the worst case is a false `0` after a failed reload, not the previous number.
  - Both become true once M1 is fixed. Re-check both lines against the patched code.
- S1 (should-fix) — a non-read marks the count known.
  - `readSettled` (`!loading && !loadFailure && !filterRefusal`) is also true on the fetch effect's `!canScope` early return (around line 2241). That return sets `loading=false` with no read.
  - `record-related-list.tsx` passes `parentId=null` while the parent record is still loading whenever `relationshipValueField` is not `id`. That list gets `countKnown=true` before its first real read, so the first read then draws `0` instead of nothing.
  - Pre-fix, that phase already drew a `0`, but the first read itself blanked. So this extends an existing false 0 rather than creating a new one.
  - As a result, changeset sentence 3 ("A list read for the first time still draws no count until it is known, never a false 0") is false on that path.
  - Either count only a read that was issued as settled (for example, gate on `canScope`), or narrow sentence 3 and add the path to the PR's Acceptance notes.
- N1 — The MutationObserver in pin 1 samples `headBadge()` when its callback runs, not on each commit. A blank-then-`0` pair committed inside one task would be coalesced. The direct held-frame assertion is what carries the pin, and the ablation shows that. The observer is a secondary signal, and its wording in the PR ("no frame without it") should not overstate it.
- N2 — The PR's labels `documentation` and `tooling` come from the auto-labeler and do not describe a `plugin-detail` UI fix. This has no effect on the verdict.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `8c0243b10f69bca4d9bcdcb1dd3926f5dfa7179d` · 2026-11-25T07:41Z

- Delta over REWORK 7153451306 at `adfe34959431666411ce5a1a54535496a6274526`:
  - Two commits, each with one parent: `5743d468fc` (fix) and `8c0243b10f` (changeset). There are no merge commits, the old head is an ancestor, and the base is still merge-base `886e97073d`.
  - The delta is 3 files, +87/-9.
- Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37220`, CLEAN, 13 items):
  - The PR is open, a draft, and based on `main`, with first line `Fixes #36822`. No closing keyword binds any other card.
  - One `patch` changeset covers `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are unchanged and correct.
- Check-runs at `8c0243b10f`: 59 total, 44 success, 15 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending.
  - `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (aggregate plus shards 1–13) and `Build & E2E UI` are all `success`.
- K = 17. `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `d7f299c0b1` is clean, and main has not touched `RelatedList.tsx` since the merge-base.
- My own reading: in a throwaway worktree at this head, the pin file gives `Tests 7 passed (7)`.
- M1 — CLOSED.
  - The render-derived `readSettled` effect is gone, and `countKnown` is now state declared beside `loadFailure` (line 1524).
  - It is set to true in the three resolve paths: the seeded read, `dataSource.find` and the raw URL. It is set to false in all three reject paths, each after the `cancelled` check.
  - New pin: rows, then a failed refetch, then Retry held → `headBadge()` is `null`, then `0`.
  - Ablation A1, all three `setCountKnown(false)` dropped: `1 failed | 6 passed`, `expected '0' to be null`, on the Retry pin only.
- S1 (old) — CLOSED as ruled.
  - The `!canScope` return, `filterRefusal` and the two no-adapter refusals never set `countKnown`. New pin: `parentId` null, then the parent → the held first read draws `null`, then `2`.
  - Ablation A3, `setCountKnown(true)` added to the `!canScope` return: `1 failed | 6 passed`, `expected '0' to be null`, on that pin only.
  - Ablation A2, the prior head's `RelatedList.tsx` (`adfe349594`) under the new pins: `2 failed | 5 passed`. Both new pins go red, so they catch exactly the two prior findings.
  - The original pin still holds. Ablation A4 drops `!countKnown` from `countPending` and gives `1 failed | 6 passed`, `expected null to be '0'`, on the 0-refetch pin.
- M2 — CLOSED, except on the S1 path below.
  - The changeset now says that once a read the list issued has answered, the count is known and a reload keeps drawing it. That is true except on the S1 path.
  - "A read that fails forgets the count, so its Retry draws no count until it answers" is true, per the A1 pin.
  - "A list's first read, including one that starts only once its parent record has loaded, still draws no count while it is in flight" is true, per the A3 pin.
  - The 速读 「第一次加载还没结果时、加载失败后点重试时,仍不显示数字」 is true. The pre-existing no-scope `0` before the first read is disclosed in the Acceptance notes.
- N1 — CLOSED. The Tests section now says the held-frame assertion carries the pin, and that the MutationObserver is a secondary sampler that coalesces commits within one task.
- S1 (should-fix) — a path that empties the rows without reading still leaves an earlier count "known". The next parent's in-flight read then draws a false `0`, which main does not draw.
  - The `!canScope` early return (and, the same way, the two no-adapter refusal arms) runs `setRelatedData([])` but not `setCountKnown(false)`. This is the same reasoning the new comment gives for the reject paths: "the rejection empties the rows, and 0 is not their count".
  - It is reachable when a mounted list's parent reloads through no scope. `record-related-list.tsx:308` resolves `parentLinkValue` to `null` while `ctx.data` loads whenever `relationshipValueField` is not `id`, and the list carries no `key`.
  - L1 probe (`pr-37220/RelatedList.l1probe-37220.test.tsx`): `ACC-1` answers 2 rows (badge `2`), then `parentId` null, then `ACC-2` with its read held.
    - At head: `{"duringNull":"0","inFlight":"0"}`.
    - Main's `RelatedList.tsx` in the same tree: `{"duringNull":"0","inFlight":null}`.
  - That makes the Acceptance note "a reparented list keeps drawing its last count during the new read" false on this path. It also falsifies the changeset's "keeps drawing that count until the new one lands" and the 速读 「刷新期间角标显示上一次成功加载的数字」. The badge draws `0`, not `2`.
  - Fix: `setCountKnown(false)` next to `setRelatedData([])` in the `!canScope` return and in both no-adapter refusal arms. Add a pin for the known → null → new-parent case with an ablation reading.
- N2 — The zone note says check-runs are "42 success, 13 skipped" at this head. The live count is 44 success and 15 expected skips (the extra skips include `Plan Test Core shards`, `Build Core` and the queue verdicts). This is a copy slip in the note and has no effect on the verdict.
- N3 — The labels `documentation` and `tooling` carry over from the auto-labeler (old N2), unchanged.
- Overlap with #37244 (head `1cb2c044f0`), both touching `RelatedList.tsx`:
  - `git merge-tree --write-tree` of the two heads is clean (tree `ccc3387eb3`). Each is also clean against `origin/main` `d7f299c0b1`.
  - Order 1: #37244 squash-lands, then #37220 merges main. Order 2 is the reverse.
  - In both orders the second PR's post-merge head and the final main keep everything: the #37244 guard (1), the six `setCountKnown(` calls, no `readSettled`, `!countKnown` in `countPending`, the #37212 describe, both #36822 pins and both changesets.
  - Both orders give the same final tree, `3b7cf14db4`.
  - Combined file: #37220's hunks are at about lines 1524, 2290–2474 and 4045. #37244's hunk is in the body-table layout effect at about line 4080. `countKnown` and `countPending` feed only the badge and chips (lines 4341, 4349, 4665), not `bodyTableDrawn`, `isEmpty` or the cap. The two changes share no state.
  - Both pin files on the combined tree: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 41 passed (41)`.
- Test evidence: logs are under `scratchpad/pr-37220/`: `test-head.log`, the four `abl-*.log` files, `probe-head.log`, `probe-base.log` and `test-combined.log`.
